resumes.text: Experienced backend engineer with 5 years building REST APIs in Python. Skilled with PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, Flask and FastAPI. Familiar with CI/CD and containerised deployments. Some exposure to machine learning models for data pipelines.

Senior machine learning engineer focusing on model development and deployment. Strong with Python, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, TensorFlow and PyTorch. Experience building ML pipelines, feature engineering, and serving models as REST APIs.
Graphic designer experienced in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, branding, layout, UI mockups, and marketing materials. Familiar with Figma and working with frontend teams on visual assets.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer

Design and implement RESTful APIs using Python frameworks. Work with PostgreSQL and containerised deployments. Some familiarity with machine learning is a plus but not required.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

We need someone to build ML pipelines and deploy models as REST APIs. Experience with Python, scikit-learn, pandas, Flask, SQL, and Docker is required.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer — Build data pipelines and feature warehouses. Implement ETL jobs, optimise queries, and collaborate with ML teams to provide scalable data infrastructure. Experience with Spark, SQL, and cloud storage.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: DevOps Engineer — Maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage Kubernetes clusters, Docker images, and cloud infra (AWS/GCP). Experience with Terraform, monitoring and logging best practices.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Frontend Engineer — Build responsive UI using React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS. Work closely with designers to implement pixel-perfect interfaces and collaborate with backend teams.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
Graphic Designer

Create visual content using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Responsible for branding, layout, and marketing design projects.
